verification_log.method: Fetched and read the commentary on Zechariah 8

Old men and women in Jerusalem's streets; the walls not completed "for another 60 years"; "let your hands be strong" since the foundation; the four fasts turned into feasts (Morgan: fasts the result of sins); many peoples seeking the LORD in Jerusalem fulfilled "in the millennial kingdom"; ten men grasping a Jew's robe — Israel drawing the nations in the Messiah's reign (Feinberg via Barker) or clinging to Jesus the Jew (Boice)
